cases.pr_body_curator_only: ### **Describe the Bug Fixed** This PR fixes an issue where sequence flows starting from a corner boundary event and connecting to an element directly on the same axis (e.g., placed completely below or to the side) would generate an awkward, looping layout with an unnecessary extra waypoint. **What changed** Updated `getBoundaryEventTargetLayout` in `BpmnLayouter.js` to explicitly check if a target element is strictly on the same vertical or horizontal axis relative to the boundary event. When it is, the layouter now correctly returns `'v'` or `'h'`, allowing the Manhattan layout engine to draw a clean, straight line instead of detouring out to the side. **Steps to verify:** 1. Attach a boundary event to the corner of a task. 2. Place another element directly below (or directly to the left/right) of that boundary event. 3. Connect the boundary event to the new element. The sequence flow will now connect in a straight line without additional waypoints. This gap is intended to increase visible differentiation between the colored segments. The width of the gap is specified in the theme settings for Meter and currently defaults to `xxsmall` which will be 3pixels generally. _Note: we may consider having the base theme have no gap and only put the gap in HPE theme versions if we want to limit impact, but it seems like this would be good for accessibility for all consumers._ The gap only comes into play when there are multiple segments in the meter. #### Where should the reviewer start? components/Meter/Circle.js #### What testing has been done on this PR? Storybook as well as custom examples to test edge cases. #### How should this be manually tested? Storybook Visualization/Meter examples (Pie and Vertical Bar Multiple especially) #### Do Jest tests follow these best practices? - [ ] `screen` is used for querying. - [ ] The correct query is used. (Refer to [this list of queries](https://testing-library.com/docs/queries/about/#priority)) - [ ] `asFragment()` is used for snapshot testing. #### Any background context you want to provide? The circular meters draw the gap as a constant width separate between the segments. This can make segments smaller than about 4 or so pixels less visible since the separator takes some space. #### What are the relevant issues? Fixes #7522 #### Screenshots (if appropriate) #### Do the grommet docs need to be updated? Yes (Meter theme now includes `gap` value) #### Should this PR be mentioned in the release notes? Yes #### Is this change backwards compatible or is it a breaking change? Backwards compatible

cases.problem_statement_zh:
主题分级：在用户切离将失去访问权限的主题时进行警告

### 需求内容

确保用户清楚在切离某个主题后，由于主题分级的变动，他们将失去对该主题的访问权限。

### 原因

我们希望对部分主题重新分级 (p7DVsv-m5X-p2)。套餐级别低于该主题级别的用户可以继续使用当前主题，但如果他们切换离开该主题，就将失去对该主题的访问权限。
